organiser_says: The commune page confirms the yearly flea market on a Saturday in August, 9-16 Uhr, and 28 August 2027; organiser Verein Flohmarkt Arlesheim. It gives no venue for the flea market (the village centre is named only for the three big Jahresmärkte).
quote: Der jährliche Flohmarkt in Arlesheim findet an einem Samstag im August von 9 bis 16 Uhr statt. Im Jahr 2027 ist dies am Samstag, 28. August.
note: 28 Aug 2027 is a Saturday. Rhythm, date and hours agree with ours. Location in the village centre is unverified, not contradicted.

claim: The organiser's page does not say twelve Saturdays or that the two locations alternate (our rhythm says 'Zwölf Samstage'); it says only 'Altstadt oder Esplanade', gives no per-date list and states the 2026 markets are fully booked for stall holders. I wrote 'ausgewählte Termine' and 'je nach Datum'.
ours: Zwölf Samstage von April bis Oktober / Twelve Saturdays, April to October
organiser_says: The city (Marktpolizei) says only: from April to October on Saturdays 07:00-14:00 in the Altstadt or on the Esplanade at the Kongresshaus. It gives no count of Saturdays, no per-date list and no rule for which place on which date.
quote: von April bis Oktober am Samstag von 07.00 bis 14.00 Uhr
note: The number twelve is not on the page and cannot be confirmed (nor refuted). Suggest "Selected Saturdays, April to October" until dates are published. See the NEW venue item below.

claim: Our next date 2026-10-17 (07:00-14:00) is not confirmable from the page.
organiser_says: The city page lists no dates. It says "Die Flohmärkte 2026 sind ausgebucht" and 2027 forms come online around March 2027. A third-party listing (j3l.ch, found by search, not an organiser) shows 17 October 2026, 07:00-14:00.
quote: Die Flohmärkte 2026 sind ausgebucht. Die Anmeldeformulare für die Flohmärkte 2027 werden voraussichtlich im März 2027 online gestellt.
note: Hours match the city's general 07-14; the date itself rests on a third party. Keep, but it is the one to watch.

claim: NEW: we show only the Esplanade, but the city says the market is in the Altstadt or on the Esplanade.
organiser_says: The market takes place "in der Altstadt oder auf der Esplanade beim Kongresshaus"; which place on which Saturday is not published.
quote: finden von April bis Oktober am Samstag von 07.00 bis 14.00 Uhr in der Altstadt oder auf der Esplanade beim Kongresshaus statt

fix.value: Altstadt oder Esplanade beim Kongresshaus (Ort je Termin laut Stadt Biel)

note: A visitor sent to the Esplanade could find the Altstadt. We show one place with no hedge. Cannot say which dates are which.

claim: Stand count: the organiser says about 220 season plus 84 day stands (about 300, matching our 300); zuerich.com says over 230 season stands. I wrote 'rund 300'.
organiser_says: About 220 season places plus 84 day places = about 304 stalls.
quote: Rund 220 Saisonplätze und 84 Tagesplätze erwarten den interessierten Besucher.
note: 300 is fine as a round figure; the zuerich.com "over 230" counts season places only.

claim: The organiser's English summary says sellers set up along Fraumünsterstrasse, Börsenstrasse, Kappelergasse and Münsterhof this year, while its German text says the market returns to the rebuilt Stadthausanlage from 2 May 2026. Our venue is Stadthausanlage; please check where the stands actually stand. The page also lists 1 August and 8 August as known cancellation dates for 2026.
organiser_says: The German news and the "Lage und Anfahrt" section say the market is in the rebuilt Stadthausanlage (7-17 Uhr, from 2 May 2026). The English summary still lists the temporary streets (Fraumünsterstrasse, Börsenstrasse, Kappelergasse, Münsterhof) and is stale. Only 1 and 8 August are named as cancelled, both past; our remaining dates 19 Sept to 31 Oct are all on the organiser's list.
quote: Jeweils wieder von 7-17 Uhr in der umgebauten und sanierten Stadthausanlage.
note: Ours is right. The English text on their page is out of date, not ours.

claim: The town page names a person as "Verantwortlich" (Uesslingen), not the town itself; the old text said "Die Stadt organisiert ihn". I did not say who organises.
organiser_says: The page is on the city's site but names a private person in Uesslingen as "Verantwortlich"; it does not say the city organises. Dates 2026: 11 Apr to 10 Oct, 2nd Saturday, 8-16 Uhr (agrees with ours).
quote: Flohmarkt im Burstelpark – jeweils am 2. Samstag im Monat
note: Not saying "Die Stadt organisiert ihn" is right. 10 Oct 2026 is the last date this year.

claim: Not on the page, so left out: "gleich hinter dem Alterszentrum" and "ten minutes from the station" (both from the old text).
ours: old text: behind the Alterszentrum; ten minutes from the station
organiser_says: Neither is on the page; it says to park on the free car park beim Rüegerholz and that driving into the Burstelpark is forbidden.
quote: spätestens ab 8 Uhr muss das Fahrzeug auf dem gebührenfreien Parkplatz beim Rüegerholz abgestellt werden
note: Unverified rather than wrong; leaving both out is right.

claim: Our old text said "bis zu 100 Ausstellende" and "ten minutes from the station"; neither is on the organiser's pages, so both are left out.
organiser_says: Rhythm, season, August break, 3 Oct and 7 Nov 2026 and 06:00-16:00 all agree with ours; held in any weather. No stall count and no walk from the station on the pages.
quote: März bis und mit November (August Sommerpause), immer am ersten Samstag im Monat, findet unser Flomi bei jeder Witterung statt.
note: Right to omit "bis zu 100 Ausstellende" and the ten minutes from the station: unverified.

claim: The event page shows a range "20.09.2025 — 19.10.2026" and puts the rhythm and dates into two flyer images I could not read. So "third Sunday of the month, March to October" and our date 18.10.2026 are NOT confirmed by text (19.10.2026 is a Monday - probably a typo on their page).
ours: 3rd Sunday of the month, March to October; 2026-10-18 09:00-16:00
organiser_says: The two flyer images on the event page (read by me) say: March to October, every 3rd Sunday, 15.3. / 19.4. / 17.5. / 21.6. / 19.7. / 16.8. / 20.9. / 18.10., 9.00-16.00 Uhr. So 18 Oct 2026 (a Sunday) is confirmed; the "19.10.2026" in the page header is a typo.
quote: März bis Oktober jeden 3. Sonntag im Monat 15.3. / 19.4. / 17.5. / 21.6. / 19.7. / 16.8. / 20.9. / 18.10. Der Flohmarkt findet statt von 9.00–16.00 Uhr
note: Ours is fully confirmed by the organiser's flyer (image only, hence the writer could not read it). Stall CHF 20 for 3 x 3 m on flyer page 2.

claim: Not on the organiser's page, so left out: "Es verkaufen Privatleute" and "ten minutes by car from Muri".
organiser_says: Neither "Privatleute" nor "ten minutes by car from Muri" is on the page or flyer.
quote: Flugplatz / 5632 Buttwil
note: Right to leave both out.

claim: Left out because no organiser page confirms them: "rund 80 Stände", "Antiquitäten, Raritäten und Vintage-Mode", "Fachwerkhäuser" (our current text and the old text). Two bodies list the market (Quartierverein Gallusplatz and Klosterviertel-Gesellschaft), so I did not name an organiser.
ours: old text: ~80 stands, antiques/rarities/vintage, Fachwerkhäuser; rhythm first Saturday April to November
organiser_says: Both bodies list the market: Quartierverein: first Saturday of the month, April to November; Klosterviertel-Gesellschaft: "Flohmarkt November" 7 Nov 2026, 7:00, Gallusplatz. None of the extras is on either page.
quote: Flohmarkt: jeden ersten Samstag im Monat, April bis November
note: Rhythm and 3 Oct / 7 Nov 2026 agree; our 2027 dates are all first Saturdays (3 Apr to 6 Nov). Leaving the extras out is right; naming no organiser is fine.
